items.title: Warner Bros. Discovery earnings, jobless claims: What to Watch
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton previews several of the biggest stories to come Thursday, August 6, including earnings out from ConocoPhillips (COP), Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD), and Airbnb (ABNB), as well as key labor data in the form of initial jobless claims.

items.title: Stronger Q2 2026 Profitability Could Be A Game Changer For Airbnb’s Platform Story (ABNB)
items.summary: In early August 2026, Airbnb, Inc. reported past second-quarter 2026 results showing sales of US$3,608 million and net income of US$816 million, with both basic and diluted earnings per share from continuing operations rising compared with a year earlier. The earnings highlight how Airbnb’s scalable global platform continues to convert higher bookings and growing boutique and independent hotel supply into improved profitability despite ongoing regulatory and market risks. items.title: Airbnb (ABNB) Stock Still Looks Like A Bargain On A 26% Run
items.summary: Airbnb has delivered a 26.3% gain over the past year, yet its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate points to the stock trading at a roughly 29.8% discount, while the broader valuation checks still flag it as only a low-score value story. Airbnb's 26.3% return over the past year suggests investors have already priced in a fair amount of optimism. items.title: ABNB Stock Soars 11% After-Hours — Airbnb Raises 2026 Outlook Again On Strong Travel Demand
items.summary: Airbnb Inc. boosted its 2026 financial outlook after posting strong second-quarter earnings, powered by accelerating booking momentum in major markets across North America and Europe.

items.title: Airbnb Boosts Full-Year Forecast on Strong Demand as AI Bets Pay Off
items.summary: The short-term-rental company said it now expects revenue to increase by at least a mid-teens rate this year, up from its prior projection for growth in the low- to mid-teens.

items.title: Airbnb's CFO Sells Nearly 4,000 Shares Worth About $575,000. Here's What That Means for Investors.

items.title: After-Hours Stocks to Watch: Sweetgreen, Airbnb, DraftKings, Rocket
